contract: Compare the AudioSession, PcmBlock, QueueLimits and Discard contracts with a caller-provided AudioDecoder. The input uses three four-sample mono units whose binary-exact normalized PCM and frequencies are known independently.

Require input backpressure and retry, no consumption before the PTS minus lead, and a start trim and decoder delay that carry across a complete packet. Compare the remaining PCM, end trim and first retained sample time.

Hold distinct sample rates in separate blocks. Compare a drain-only block with absent PTS and verify that a caller's occupied block is retained. After stop or unload, verify reset of queued input, carried drain and diagnostics.

Exercise Fail and Skip for a refused unit and an independent drain-only refusal. Compare the resulting PCM, counts, state and typed last error. A rejected StreamSelection audio configuration changes neither session.
